scope: Normalized fields retained from the seven public GitHub issue-collection responses already inspected; no new API query.
classification: A pull_request property distinguishes PRs; automated_actor_entries counts actor_type Bot or actor_login ending [bot] or equal to Copilot. This is not a complete measure of automation.
limits: Pages were read during one investigation, not as a transactional snapshot.
Creation timestamps on currently public objects do not independently prove historical repository visibility.
